data.investment_objective: To generate income primarily through investment in Gilts of various maturities. However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
• Government Securities across maturity = 80%-100% 
• Other Debt Securities and Money Market Instruments = 0%-20%
The Scheme may also take exposure to:
• Securitized debt up to 20% of the net assets in other debt and money market instruments
• Derivatives up to 100% of the net assets
